title: The self hosted control center for every coding agent you use
description:
Running Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini in separate tabs is chaos, not a workflow. Open Hands Agent Canvas fixes that. It's a self hosted control center for every coding agent you already use, always on, running from your laptop, a Mac Mini, or a cloud VM. Switch backends without losing focus, decompose GitHub issues into tasks automatically, publish reports to Slack, and trigger runs on a schedule or webhook. No vendor lock in. You bring the model and the agent, you own the infrastructure.
